paragraphs: R' Yaakov, his son. Gittin, chapter 1, halakhah 2.[^1]

notes.text: Yaakov's title is abbreviated, retained as R'. His son has an unnamed antecedent in the body, contextually the separate heading. The chapter/halakhah locator suggests Jerusalem Talmud Gittin, but no named edition or mapping was verified.
